_meta.purpose: Durable record of LIVE operational-readiness gates. Each gate is a read-only check that PROPOSES a state; a human DISPOSES the resulting action.
_meta.principle: Auto-orchestrate the proposing, never the disposing. Gates detect and report — they never deploy, merge, provision hardware, charge, or harden a route.
_meta.growRule: Add a gate ONLY when the work it verifies is real and verifiable. Do not add speculative gates ahead of the work — no rows for stewardship re-land, admin-route hotfix, early-member continuity, or beta-to-paid until each one lands and is testable.
_meta.invariant: Every gate MUST have mutates:false. A check that would mutate production is not a gate.
_meta.statusNote: result is recorded after the gate runs; this file is not auto-written-back yet (a future enhancement, not claimed as live).

opsGates.description: Acceptance gate for the onboarding session-mint fix: confirm no new member is created without a server session.
opsGates.check: SELECT count(*) AS new_members_sessionless FROM members m WHERE m.created_at > '2026-06-10 20:22:48+00'::timestamptz AND m.password_hash IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth_sessions s WHERE s.member_id = m.id);
opsGates.runVia: ssh soullab@minisforum -> docker exec maia-postgres psql -U soullab maia_consciousness
opsGates.onNonZero: Grep maia-sovereign logs for '[MEMBERS] Session creation failed (non-fatal)'. Present -> the createSession degrade fired (investigate why createSession fails; member creation still succeeded). Absent -> a different sessionless-member generator still exists; do NOT start DM hardening.
opsGates.proposes: The session-mint fix holds under live traffic (zero sessionless new members since deploy).
opsGates.disposes: Human — a passing gate green-lights the HELD DM auth hardening work (currently gated on exactly this).
